relationships.subject: MMPs
relationships.evidence_quote: the secretion of MMPs by endometrial cells promotes extracellular matrix degradation and invasion [111]

relationships.subject: PGE2
relationships.evidence_quote: Elevated levels of TNF-α, IL-1β, and IL-6, along with prostaglandins like PGE2, perpetuate inflammation and pain [108].

key_findings: Review of endometriosis pathophysiology: PI3K/Akt, Wnt/β-catenin and JAK/STAT pathways, MMPs, VEGF and PGE2 drive lesion growth, inflammation and pain.
